content: तलः, -लम् [तल्-अच्] .²1 A surface; भुवस्तलमिव व्योम कुर्वन् व्योमेव भूतलम् <ls>R. 4. 29</ls>; sometimes used at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> without much alteration of meaning; महीतलम् ‘surface of the earth’ {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} earth itself; शुद्धे तु दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा <ls>Ś. 7. 32</ls>; नभस्तलम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The palm of the hand; <ls>R. 6. 18</ls>. .²3 The sole of the foot; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 36. 8</ls>. .²4 The fore-arm. .²5 A slap with the hand. .²6 Lowness, inferiority of position. .²7 A lower part, part underneath, base, foot, bottom; रेवारोधसि वेतसीतरुतले चेतः समुत्कण्ठते <ls>K. P. 1</ls>. .²8 (Hence) The ground under a tree or any other object, shelter afforded by anything; फणी मयूरस्य तले निषीदति <ls>Ṛs. 1. 13</ls>. .²9 A hole, pit. .²10 A span. .{@-लः@} .²1 The hilt of a sword. .²2 The palmyra tree. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²4 Pressing the strings of a lute with the left hand; तत्र तत्र महानादैरुत्कृष्टतलनादितैः <ls>Mb. 1. 221. 60</ls>. .²5 A division of hell. .{@-लम्@} .²1 A pond. .²2 A forest, wood; भस्मप्रस्तरशायी च भूमिशय्या च तलेषु च <ls>Mb. 12. 303. 11</ls>. .²3 Cause, origin, motive. .²4 A leathern fence worn round the left arm (तला also in this sense); उद्यतैरायुधैश्चित्रास्तलबद्धाः कलापिनः <ls>Mb. 6. 16. 14</ls>.
